title: Perturbative Hairy Black Branes in the $G_{2}$-Invariant Sector of Dyonic ISO(7) Gauged Supergravity
summary: We construct perturbative black-brane solutions carrying neutral scalar hair in the $G_{2}$-invariant truncation of four-dimensional dyonic $\mathcal{N}=8$ ISO(7) gauged supergravity, an exact consistent truncation of massive type~IIA supergravity on $S^{6}$. Expanding around the $G_{2}$-symmetric AdS$_{4}$-Schwarzschild black brane in powers of a dimensionless scalar-charge parameter $\eps$, we show that the perturbation hierarchy reduces, order by order, to a nested sequence of inhomogeneous Legendre equations (demonstrated through second order).
